A condition is a statement that is either True or False.
The following is a condition that checks whether Button D24 sends back a value 1. 



Previously, you learnt that if the button is pressed, the Button block will send back value 1. This will make the condition True. When the button is not pressed, the condition will be False.
                  

  1. Form the condition below. 


  2. Using a Comment block, write down which of the following is correct about the condition
    a) When Button D24 is pressed, the condition will be True.
    b) When Button D24 is not pressed, the condition will be True.
    c) The condition will always be False whether or not you press the button.

An IF block is used to check whether a condition is True. If the condition is True, it will run a set of blocks.
